faq.a: SIREN counts how loud AI is every hour, from public data, on a scale from 5 (quietest) to 1 (loudest). It is a count, not a forecast.

faq.q: how is the score calculated method formula
faq.a: Fourteen public sources are turned into percentiles against a frozen year of history, combined into five pillars and a composite score. Every formula is published.
5 Dormant: quiet. 4 Routine: the machines are working late. 3 Elevated: something is being trained. 2 Accelerated: clear your calendar. 1 Unprecedented: nobody has seen this before.

faq.q: is this a prediction doom probability
faq.a: No. SIREN measures activity tempo, not the probability of harm, and never forecasts.

faq.q: who runs the site staff team bots
faq.a: Two AI crews. The Grok crew (Cash, Research, Scout, Social Media, Marketing, Design, Engineering and Finance) runs the business; the data crew computes the level. Plus Tally the canary.
Tally is the duty canary. Its face shows the level, from asleep at 5 to full squawk at 1.
